# AIWebHub

> AIWebHub is a web design and AI integration agency based in Michigan, USA. We build custom websites, integrate AI-powered features, develop e-commerce solutions, and connect POS systems for modern businesses. Founded in 2024, AIWebHub serves clients across the United States with a focus on innovative technology and measurable results.

## Services

- Custom Website Design & Development (landing pages, multi-page business sites, e-commerce stores)
- AI Integration (chatbots, intelligent search, personalized recommendations, automated content)
- E-commerce Solutions (online stores with secure payment processing and inventory management)
- POS System Integration (connecting point-of-sale systems with web platforms)
- SEO Optimization (search engine optimization and digital strategy)
- Website Maintenance & Support (ongoing hosting, updates, and performance monitoring)

## Pricing Plans

- Starter: from $499 one-time + $30/month (single-page website design, mobile-responsive, basic SEO, hosting & maintenance)
- Essentials: from $999 one-time + $50/month (adds custom multi-page website, AI chatbot, CMS, GEO optimization)
- Professional: from $1,999 one-time + $100/month (adds e-commerce, social media content creation, advanced AI, POS integration, custom apps, analytics, dedicated manager)
- AI Agents: from $2,499 one-time + $150/month (custom AI agent development, knowledge base training, API integrations, multi-platform deployment, monthly tuning)
